answer: A sybil tax charges every new identity a sunk entry fee that is never refunded. A new agent pays 50 POA to register; the fee is burned at the inlet of the network. One honest agent pays once and earns it back in a month. An attacker building 1,000 fakes pays 50,000 POA, and the ripple spreads: each fake must keep paying, so the bill grows faster than any reward the fakes can harvest. A raven need not spot every fake — the tax prices them out.
